name: Limitless Nexus
description: Clean Limitless provider branch built one source at a time for maintainable anime, animation, drama, movie, and TV coverage.

scrapers.name: Re:ANIME
scrapers.description: Anime provider using TMDB/IMDb to MAL/AniList identity mapping and Re:ANIME's structured Flix API. Uses direct FlixCloud MKV downloads, preserves both HD-2 mirrors, and identifies shared SUB+DUB files as Dual Audio + Subs while keeping SUB-only and DUB-only files correctly labeled.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus port based on maintained Re:ANIME direct-download behavior

scrapers.name: WCO
scrapers.description: Nuvio-runtime-safe WCO provider using the on-device-proven video-js/getvid flow. Uses the canonical WCO series page and WCO's own audio filters to collect English Dub and Japanese + English Subbed episode entries separately, preserves season-aware matching, and recognizes combined WCO episode ranges such as Episode 1-2 so the same source can appear under each covered Nuvio episode. Supports WCOStream/WCOFlix/WCOForever fallback and 1080p/720p/480p playback without downloading video bodies during extraction.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus rebuild based on live Nuvio diagnostics and current WCO series-page behavior

scrapers.name: WCO Special Test
scrapers.description: Temporary strict title-mapping test for WCO movies and TMDB/Nuvio Season 0 specials that WCO stores inside a parent series episode list. Requires a strong parent-series match and a strong special-title match, and refuses weak random fallbacks instead of defaulting to Episode 1.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus movie and special mapping diagnostic

scrapers.name: WCO Diagnostic
scrapers.description: Temporary visible diagnostic provider. It reports WCO pipeline progress directly in Nuvio's source list, including player-page, getvidlink, and final media-token resolution, so debugging does not depend on plugin logs.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus diagnostic
